statement: The natural open problem is to improve the running times for computing the yolk (and extremal yolk) even further. It seems believable, that for d > 3, the log factors in Theorem 16 and Theorem 25 might not be necessary. We leave this as an open problem for further research.
context: 5 Conclusion The natural open problem is to improve the running times for computing the yolk (and extremal yolk) even further. It seems believable, that for d > 3, the log factors in Theorem 16 and Theorem 25 might not be necessary. We leave this as an open problem for further research.
